description: Build 5B: Mobile UI enhancements — passenger RatingScreen wired to real API, passenger EarningsScreen rewritten from stub to real data, driver-app EarningsScreen updated to use new API endpoints + history section, new RatePassengerScreen created, navigation updated, ProfileScreen and HomeScreen updated with live driver rating. Depends on FEAT-002 (needs the backend endpoints to exist). Independent of FEAT-001's mobile changes in terms of file conflicts.
steps: Step 1: Read apps/passenger-app/screens/RatingScreen.tsx in full. Add axios import, AsyncStorage import, ActivityIndicator import. Add const API_BASE. Destructure tripId from route.params (alongside existing driver, fare, pickup, destination). Add const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false). Replace the submitRating function body with: setSubmitting(true); get token from AsyncStorage; axios.post(`${API_BASE}/ratings`, { trip_id: tripId, ratee_id: driver.id, rating, review: comment }, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }); on success navigation.popToTop(); on error Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to submit rating'); always setSubmitting(false). On the Submit button, show ActivityIndicator when submitting and disable it.

Step 2: Read apps/passenger-app/screens/EarningsScreen.tsx in full (it is a stub). Rewrite this file completely. On mount: get token from AsyncStorage, call GET /earnings/summary and GET /earnings/history?period=week with Bearer auth headers. State: summary (or null), history (array), loading (bool), error (string|null), selectedPeriod ('today'|'week'|'month'). Period selector changes trigger re-fetch of history. Display: green summary card with today net + week net + trips_today; period selector buttons; history ScrollView with rows (date, passenger_name, net_amount TSh formatted, payment_method). Loading spinner during fetch; error state with retry. 'Withdraw Earnings' button at bottom → Alert 'Coming Soon'. Use only react-native primitives + axios + AsyncStorage — no ThemeContext, no react-native-vector-icons.

Step 3: Read apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/EarningsScreen.tsx in full. Change DriverAPI.getEarnings() to DriverAPI.getEarningsSummary() in loadEarnings(). Add state: const [history, setHistory] = useState<any[]>([]). Add loadHistory async function that calls DriverAPI.getEarningsHistory(selectedPeriod) and sets history. Add useEffect that depends on [selectedPeriod] calling loadHistory. After the 'All Time' summarySection, add a historySection View with sectionTitle + rows mapped from history (date, passenger_name, net_amount). Add 'Withdraw Earnings' TouchableOpacity at the bottom of the ScrollView that shows Alert 'Withdrawal coming soon'. Add new styles: historySection, historyRow, withdrawButton. Keep all existing ThemeContext and useTranslation usage.

Step 4: Create apps/driver-app/src/screens/trip/RatePassengerScreen.tsx from scratch. Props/route: StackNavigationProp + RouteProp typed to HomeStackParamList['RatePassenger']. Params: tripId, passengerId, passengerName, fare. UI: header section showing passengerName initial in colored circle + passengerName + fare formatted as TSh. Interactive 5-star row (1-5 TouchableOpacity stars, active = yellow #FFB300, inactive = #ddd). Optional TextInput comment (multiline, border). Submit button calling DriverAPI.submitRating({ trip_id: tripId, ratee_id: passengerId, rating, review: comment }). Loading state on button. On success: navigation.navigate('HomeMain'). On error: Alert.alert('Hitilafu', 'Imeshindwa kutuma tathmini'). Use useTheme() for colors. Style to match ActiveTripScreen.tsx card/shadow conventions.

Step 5: Read apps/driver-app/src/navigation/MainNavigator.tsx in full. Add to HomeStackParamList: RatePassenger: { tripId: string; passengerId: string; passengerName: string; fare: number }. Also add passengerId?: string to HomeStackParamList['ActiveTrip']. Add import of RatePassengerScreen from '../screens/trip/RatePassengerScreen'. Add HomeStack.Screen for RatePassenger with options={{ title: 'Tathmini Abiria' }}.

Step 6: Read apps/driver-app/src/screens/trip/ActiveTripScreen.tsx in full. In confirmPayment() function, replace the // TODO: Send to backend API comment and the setShowPaymentModal(false) call with: setShowPaymentModal(false); navigation.navigate('RatePassenger', { tripId: route.params.tripId, passengerId: route.params.passengerId ?? '', passengerName: trip.passengerName, fare: trip.fare }); Also update setTrip call to happen before navigation (order: setTrip, setShowPaymentModal(false), navigate).

Step 7: Read apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/ProfileScreen.tsx in full. Add import of DriverAPI. Add state: const [driverRating, setDriverRating] = useState<{ average: number; count: number } | null>(null). In useEffect on mount (or add one if not present), add: DriverAPI.getDriverRating(user?.id ?? '').then(r => setDriverRating(r)).catch(() => {}). In the JSX header/profile section, below phone number Text, add: {driverRating && driverRating.count > 0 && (<Text style={styles.ratingBadge}>⭐ {driverRating.average.toFixed(1)} ({driverRating.count} {t('ratings') || 'ratings'})</Text>)}. Add ratingBadge style.

Step 8: Read apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/HomeScreen.tsx in full. Import useAuth from '../../contexts/AuthContext'. Add const { user } = useAuth(). Change DriverAPI.getEarnings() to DriverAPI.getEarningsSummary() in loadData(). Add state: const [myRating, setMyRating] = useState<number>(4.8). In the existing loadData useEffect, also call: if (user?.id) { DriverAPI.getDriverRating(user.id).then(r => setMyRating(r.average)).catch(() => {}); }. In the rating statCard in the statsGrid, replace the hardcoded '4.8' with {myRating.toFixed(1)}.
Step 9: Run verification: cd apps/driver-app && npx tsc --noEmit; cd apps/passenger-app && npx tsc --noEmit. Fix any errors found.
acceptance_criteria: apps/passenger-app/screens/RatingScreen.tsx calls POST /ratings API and shows ActivityIndicator while submitting
apps/passenger-app/screens/EarningsScreen.tsx fetches from /earnings/summary and /earnings/history with period selector
apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/EarningsScreen.tsx uses getEarningsSummary() and shows history rows
apps/driver-app/src/screens/trip/RatePassengerScreen.tsx exists with star rating, comment input, and DriverAPI.submitRating call
apps/driver-app/src/navigation/MainNavigator.tsx has RatePassenger in HomeStackParamList and HomeNavigator
apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/ProfileScreen.tsx shows live driver rating from DriverAPI.getDriverRating
apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/HomeScreen.tsx uses getEarningsSummary and shows live myRating
